```python
StaticValue(index: int, path: Tuple[Any, ...], value: Any, kind: str)
```

Part of [`evoxc.trace`](/api/evoxc/trace/)

Record of one static (graph-specializing) input or output leaf.

## Attributes

- `index` · `int` — Flat leaf index in the input (or output) tree.

- `path` · `Tuple[Any, ...]` — Pytree key path of the leaf within the tree.

- `value` · `Any` — The static Python value itself (None/bool/int/float/complex/
  str/Enum/dtype/slice/ndarray — see the static-value predicate in
  `./trace.py`).

- `kind` · `str` — `type(value).__qualname__` — validated at run time so e.g. a
  recorded `1` never matches a passed `True`.
